description: Electricity And Peak Load is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset presents statistics on electricity installed capacity and peak load in Qatar over the years. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are electricity, installed capacity, peak load, energy, qatar. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-05-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
